messages.text_excerpt:
Hi Kay,

I hope you're doing well!

I wanted to let you know that *Anthony has recently been promoted* within

our Bookkeeping Department in recognition of his hard work and dedication.

While we're excited for him as he takes on this new opportunity, I also

wanted to personally assure you that your bookkeeping services will

continue without interruption.

To continue providing you with timely and consistent support, we will be

assigning a *new Bookkeeper* to manage your account moving forward. We will

conduct a structured transition over the next *15 days* to ensure

everything is handed over smoothly and seamlessly.

Most importantly, *Anthony will continue to be involved throughout the

transition*. He will work closely with your new Bookkeeper, sharing all of

your account-specific processes, preferences, and important details to

ensure they are fully prepared before taking over. Even after the

transition, Anthony will remain available to provide guidance and support

whenever needed to help ensure continuity.

I also want to reassure you that *I will continue to be your Customer

Success Manager*. I will remain your primary point of contact and will

continue overseeing your account, ensuring everything stays on track and

that you continue receiving the same level of service, communication, and

support you've come to expect from our team.

As part of this transition, I would like to schedule a meeting with

you to *introduce

your new Bookkeeper*, review the current status of your books, discuss any

outstanding items, and answer any questions you may have. This will also

give us an opportunity to ensure everyone is aligned moving forward.

Please know that your books remain in good hands. This transition is simply

a change in day-to-day support, not a fresh start. Our goal is to make the

process as seamless as possible while maintaining the quality, consistency,

and attention to detail that your account deserves.

Thank you for your continued trust and partnership. We truly appreciate the

opportunity to support your business and look forward to continuing to work

with you.

INSIDE THE LAB

A real acquisition story from inside the Lab, from searcher to owner.

🎉 CONGRATULATIONS, MICHAEL S.

Acquisition Lab member Michael S. recently acquired a 42-year-old commercial printing and distribution business in Minneapolis with approximately $7 million in revenue.

The deal itself is a great reminder that structure can create opportunity.

Michael acquired the business at approximately 4x SDE, financing the purchase with a 65% conventional bank loan, 15% forgivable seller note, and 20% equity from personal capital and investors. After closing, he raised an additional $750,000 to fund future growth.

His biggest advice, though, had nothing to do with financing.

"Don't underestimate closing mechanics. Learn cash-free, debt-free and net working capital early. Surprises here create enormous last-minute risk."

Congratulations, Michael! We can't wait to see what you build next.
